note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate are all described; some letters in the soldier and worker passages are misread by OCR but the measurements are legible; the lectotype measurement table, synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier antennae 15–16-segmented, mandibles short and thick, close to half the head length, the proximal half of the left mandible with 3 distinct denticles and the right mandible without denticles. Alate fore wing length 20.5–22.0 mm, antennae 19-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum yellow to yellowish brown, the front of the head slightly paler; antennae brownish, paler at the base; mandibles dark brown, yellowish brown at the base; body pale yellow, the pronotum sometimes slightly darker. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length 3.50–5.25 mm. Head capsule oval, widest posteriorly (length to mandibular base 0.98–1.50 mm, maximum width 0.85–1.32 mm; ratio of width to length 0.83–0.90, 0.86–0.88 in the syntypes); sides distinctly narrowing anteriorly (cephalic convergence index, i.e. width at mandibular base / maximum width, 0.64–0.68 in the syntypes). Antennae 15–16-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 the shortest. Labrum broad, ligulate, with 6–7 rather long setae on each side; apex slightly pointed (length 0.20–0.30 mm, width 0.28–0.38 mm). Mandibles short and thick, about half the head length (length 0.54–0.72 mm, 0.68 mm in the syntypes); ratio of mandible length to head length 0.45–0.60, 0.52–0.54 in the syntypes. Proximal half of the left mandible with 3 distinct denticles; right mandible without denticles, but sometimes with a few small serrations near the base. Postmentum subquadrate, widest at the anterior third (length 0.64–0.88 mm, maximum width 0.41–0.53 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, sparsely hairy; anterior margin weakly to distinctly concave, posterior margin weakly to distinctly notched (both weak in the syntypes); length 0.38–0.55 mm, width 0.62–0.90 mm (0.50 mm and 0.73–0.75 mm respectively in the syntypes). Mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin weakly incurved. Metanotum as wide as or slightly wider than the pronotum, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule light brown, paler anteriorly; antennae straw yellow, darker apically; postclypeus slightly paler than the head capsule; body yellowish white. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, widest near the antennal bases (length to mandibular base 1.20–1.35 mm, maximum width 1.35–1.45 mm). Fontanelle plate small, round, semi-transparent, visible only in strong light. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and about as long as segment 5; segment 4 slightly larger than segment 3. Postclypeus inflated and with a few setae; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin shallowly concave (length 0.40–0.48 mm, width 0.70–0.75 mm).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown to chestnut brown, paler anteriorly; postclypeus pale yellow to yellowish brown; antennae brownish; pronotum as dark as the head capsule, with a pale yellow T-shaped mark and shoulder patches; abdominal tergites brown, sternites paler. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length including wings 23.0–25.0 mm, excluding wings 11.0–12.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.44–1.80 mm, maximum width including compound eyes 1.89–2.20 mm). Fontanelle a minute round spot, not raised. Compound eyes medium-sized, moderately protruding (maximum diameter 0.52–0.63 mm, minimum diameter 0.45–0.58 mm), close to the lower margin of the head (compound eye–lower head margin distance 0.12–0.13 mm). Ocellus elliptical (long diameter 0.19–0.20 mm, short diameter 0.13–0.16 mm), separated from the compound eye by about its short diameter or slightly more (ocellus–compound eye distance 0.15–0.19 mm). Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal, segment 5 the shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, slightly less than half as long as wide (length 0.39–0.45 mm, width 0.83–0.90 mm). Pronotum nearly semicircular (length 0.87–1.05 mm, width 1.71–2.00 mm); anterior margin almost straight, the depression indistinct; posterior margin slightly concave. Wings long, fore wing length 20.5–22.0 mm, hind wing length 19.1–20.0 mm.
